prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production damaged sprite atlas for the illustrated fighting game Brasa. Image1 is the EXACT clean taro_roque reactions atlas to edit. Preserve the EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows (SIXTEEN figures) regular grid of Image1, every unique pose at its corresponding index, consistent character size, original anatomy/proportions, face, eyes, clothing colors, species, limbs and equipment. ORDER left to right by rows: light hit recoil with a flinch, body hit hunched clutching stomach, heavy hit recoiling backward with arms drawn inward, critical stagger sagging and unbalanced with lowered guard (all first-row poses RECEIVE damage, NEVER throw a punch); falling start, falling midpoint, lying grounded, get-up supported on hand; get-up kneeling, get-up rising, low-health hunched guard, tired victory start; tired victory raised fist, transformation start, transformation peak, transformed idle. All silhouettes must fit fully in their own equal-size cell, with ample clear gutter on EVERY side and between rows; do not crop paws, ears, wings, tails, raised fists, falling limbs or weapons. Characters face right as reference. Paint convincing physical battle damage directly in ALL characters: localized natural facial contusion under the fur/skin, weary narrowed eyelids and pained expression, slightly tired shoulders in rest poses, torn seams/edges of existing clothing, small scuffed areas of underlying fur/skin, a convincingly torn trouser knee if trousers exist, frayed existing scarf/cloth, realistic worn wraps/leather, dust integrated in paint. Keep face readable and outfit coverage recognizable; do not invent new equipment or bandages. Consistent damage locations across poses. Preserve the original handcrafted painted style, warm upper-left illumination, dimensional shading, texture and color palette. No flat black marks, vector scratches, floating symbols, stickers, auras or effect particles.  Roque is THIS exact sturdy badger variant with black-white mask, tan-brown sleeveless martial-arts tunic, ochre sash, dark trousers, jade wrist beads and off-white wraps. Preserve his warm brown clothing, no gray tunic, no beard. Illustrate swollen weary eye, worn cloth seams, frayed ochre sash and torn existing knee. BACKGROUND: a perfectly uniform flat saturated chroma green #00FF00 matte, also in every internal gap between limbs, under armpits, through tears, around tails and between cloth strips, for technical extraction. NO checkerboard, no background texture, no gradient, no black/white canvas, no cast shadows outside the character, no text, labels, borders or grid lines. This is an atlas of distinct sprites, not a poster. High resolution 2048x2048.
